feedback.robotCommandsWall: Oops! Step {{step}} didn't work. Try changing the order or adding a turn!
feedback.robotCommandsNoPick: The robot didn't pick the apple. Try adding Pick apple when standing on the right square!
feedback.robotCommandsIncomplete: Not done yet! The robot needs to reach the apple square and pick the apple.
feedback.teachRobotWeak: With few examples or wrong labels, the robot might get confused.
feedback.teachRobotSuccess: Awesome! The robot learned really well from your labeled examples!

levelSelect.bannerAlt: Buddy Bot as an AI detective
levelSelect.title: AI Detective Challenge
levelSelect.subtitle: Ready to hunt for clues of artificial intelligence?

youtube_suggests_videos.explain: This uses AI because the system learns from videos you watch to make suggestions.

fan_button_spin.text: A fan spins when you press a button.
fan_button_spin.explain: No AI. It just follows a normal physical button.

alarm_at_six.text: An alarm clock rings at 6 o'clock.
alarm_at_six.explain: No AI. It only rings at the time you set before.

flashlight_switch.text: A flashlight turns on when you flip the switch.
flashlight_switch.explain: No AI. Electricity flows and lights up the flashlight right away.

robot_vacuum_avoids.text: A robot vacuum avoids tables and chairs at home.
robot_vacuum_avoids.explain: This uses AI because the machine uses sensors and learns to spot obstacles while moving.

streetlight_sensor.text: A streetlight turns on at night using a light sensor.
streetlight_sensor.explain: No AI. This is just a light sensor turning electricity on and off.

calculator_addition.explain: No AI. It only runs fixed math formulas built into it.

phone_spellcheck.text: A phone fixes spelling mistakes while you type a message.
phone_spellcheck.explain: This uses AI because the smart keyboard learns from how people type to guess the right word.

faucet_proximity.text: A faucet runs when you put your hand under it with a proximity sensor.
faucet_proximity.explain: No AI. The distance sensor just opens a normal water valve when blocked.

camera_beautify_filter.text: A camera app smooths skin and makes eyes look bigger.
camera_beautify_filter.explain: This uses AI because the app detects face shapes and applies smart beauty effects.

tv_remote_channel.text: A TV changes channels when you press a number on the remote.
tv_remote_channel.explain: No AI. The TV only receives a fixed infrared signal for each button.

fridge_ice_maker.text: A fridge makes ice cubes when the tray is full of water.
fridge_ice_maker.explain: No AI. This is an automatic machine that dumps ice when cold enough — it doesn't learn.

google_translate.text: Google Translate translates an English sentence.
google_translate.explain: This uses AI because it learned from millions of sentence examples to translate languages.

camera_face_detection.explain: This uses AI because the computer learned to tell different faces apart.

email_spam_filter.text: An email inbox filters spam ads.
email_spam_filter.explain: This uses AI because the system analyzes words to block spam mail.

self_driving_stop_sign.text: A self-driving car stops at a red stop sign.
self_driving_stop_sign.explain: This uses AI because cameras recognize and process signs to stop the car.

ac_wind_tracking.text: An air conditioner adjusts wind direction when someone is in the room.
ac_wind_tracking.explain: This uses AI because an infrared sensor spots where people are to aim the wind.

maps_traffic_routing.text: Google Maps shows a route that avoids traffic jams.
maps_traffic_routing.explain: This uses AI because the system studies movement data from millions of people to predict jams.

factory_robot_arm.text: A factory robot arm repeats the same assembly motion.
factory_robot_arm.explain: No AI. It only follows exact pre-programmed steps and doesn't learn new things.

smart_lock_face_id.text: A smart lock opens when it recognizes Mom or Dad's Face ID.
smart_lock_face_id.explain: This uses AI because the system uses recognition to remember and study face features.

ai_image_from_text.text: An app draws a picture when you describe it with your voice.
ai_image_from_text.explain: This uses generative AI trained on millions of pictures to create new images.

buddy_bot_suggestions.text: Buddy Bot suggests smart follow-up questions while you chat.
buddy_bot_suggestions.explain: This uses AI to study the words you type and find a good next topic.

xray_medical_analysis.text: A computer system analyzes X-ray images to help doctors spot lung illness.
xray_medical_analysis.explain: This uses AI trained on millions of medical images to learn signs of injury.

song_recognition.text: An app names a song when you let it hear a short clip of music.
song_recognition.explain: This uses AI to study sound frequencies and quickly match them to millions of songs.

levelSelect.bannerAlt: AI giving a wrong answer that needs checking
levelSelect.title: AI Mistake Checker
levelSelect.subtitle: AI isn't always smart or correct. Let's practice checking facts!

fish_on_tree.explain: Fish only live in water and breathe with gills.

sun_rises_east.text: The sun always rises in the east.
sun_rises_east.explain: That's right — the sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

dog_with_wings.text: Dogs have wings and can fly.
dog_with_wings.explain: Dogs walk on four legs and don't have wings to fly.

blue_ripe_banana.explain: Ripe bananas are yellow. Blue ones are made up or drawn wrong by AI!

cat_eight_legs.text: Cats are animals with 8 legs so they can run very fast.
cat_eight_legs.explain: Cats only have 4 legs. AI sometimes draws cats with extra legs!

rainbow_seven_colors.text: A rainbow often appears after rain and has 7 colors.
rainbow_seven_colors.explain: Correct! This is a natural effect when sunlight shines through raindrops.

bread_grows_in_field.text: Bread grows in wheat fields like wheat plants do.
bread_grows_in_field.explain: People make bread from wheat flour and bake it — it doesn't grow in a field!

water_boil_10c.explain: Water boils at 100°C. At 10°C water is very cold!

apple_colors.text: Apples can be red, green, or yellow.
apple_colors.explain: That's right! Real apples come in these colors and taste yummy.

chicken_fish_eggs.text: Chickens lay eggs that hatch into cute baby fish.
chicken_fish_eggs.explain: Chickens lay eggs that hatch into chicks, not fish.

all_birds_fly.explain: Not all of them! Penguins and ostriches cannot fly.

ai_always_correct.explain: AI can be wrong or make things up. Check with a book or your teacher.

all_photos_real.text: Every photo you see is a real photo.
all_photos_real.explain: Today AI can make pictures that look very real but are actually fake.

robot_has_emotions.text: A robot feels happy and sad like a person.
robot_has_emotions.explain: Robots only copy programmed expressions — they don't have real hearts or feelings.

humans_on_mars_1969.text: People built cities and lived on Mars starting in 1969.
humans_on_mars_1969.explain: In 1969 people first walked on the Moon. We can't live on Mars yet.

all_liquid_sweet.text: All liquid water on Earth is sweet and safe to drink straight from nature.
all_liquid_sweet.explain: Sea water is salty. River and lake water may have germs and needs cleaning first.

ocean_blue_ink.text: The ocean is blue because someone poured blue ink into it.
ocean_blue_ink.explain: The blue color comes from sunlight reflecting and being absorbed through the water.

ai_six_fingers.text: AI drew a human hand with 6 fingers that looks very natural.
ai_six_fingers.explain: Yes — generative AI sometimes adds extra fingers because it doesn't fully understand human bodies.

t_rex_amazon.text: Online news says T-rex dinosaurs still live in the Amazon rainforest.
t_rex_amazon.explain: Dinosaurs died out millions of years ago. This is surely fake news or AI-made!

astronaut_horse_mars.text: A photo from last year shows an astronaut riding a horse on Mars.
astronaut_horse_mars.explain: It may look real, but no one rides horses on Mars yet. It could be edited or AI-made!

ai_medicine_no_doctor.text: AI invented a cure-all medicine without a doctor checking it.
ai_medicine_no_doctor.explain: Very dangerous! AI only suggests from old data and can't make medicine alone. Always ask a doctor!

clear_cat_photos.explain: Clear photos with correct labels help AI learn better.

blurry_dog_photo.explain: Blurry photos make it hard for AI to see key features.

classmate_phone.explain: Phone numbers are personal data — don't use them in AI lessons.

diverse_apple_photos.text: Many photos of red, green, and yellow apples.
diverse_apple_photos.explain: Different examples help AI recognize things better.

mislabeled_banana.text: A banana photo labeled as an orange.
mislabeled_banana.explain: Wrong labels teach AI the wrong thing.

student_home_address.explain: Home addresses must be protected and not shared.

robot_toy_angles.text: Toy robot photos taken from many angles.
robot_toy_angles.explain: Many viewpoints help AI learn full details.

unclear_cat_or_dog.text: A photo where you can't tell cat or dog, but a label was forced anyway.
unclear_cat_or_dog.explain: Unclear examples should be checked again before using.

password_request.text: AI asks for your school account password.
password_request.explain: Passwords are secret. Don't share them with AI or strangers.

science_homework_help.text: You ask AI to explain a science lesson in 3 short points.
science_homework_help.explain: This is a safe way to use AI for learning.

stomach_medicine_advice.text: AI tells you to take medicine when your stomach hurts.
stomach_medicine_advice.explain: Health questions need a parent, teacher, or doctor.

robot_art_with_label.text: You want to make a classroom robot picture and label it as AI-made.
robot_art_with_label.explain: Making safe art and labeling it clearly is a great habit.

address_for_better_story.text: AI asks for your home address to tell a better story.
address_for_better_story.explain: Your home address is private information.

unverified_online_news.text: AI says strange online news is 100% true.
unverified_online_news.explain: Strange news needs checking with trusted sources and a grown-up.

why_ai_can_be_wrong.text: You ask AI: Why can AI be wrong?
why_ai_can_be_wrong.explain: Learning AI's limits helps you use it more wisely.

real_face_photo_upload.text: You upload a real photo of a friend's face for AI to edit.
real_face_photo_upload.explain: Real people's photos need permission and privacy protection.

bat.hint: It flies like a bird but is actually a mammal that has babies!

dolphin.label: Dolphin
dolphin.hint: It lives in water like a fish but is really a mammal!

tomato.label: Tomato
tomato.hint: People often think it's a vegetable used in soup.

avocado.label: Avocado
avocado.hint: Creamy and not very sweet, but still a fruit!

mini_car.label: Mini plastic car
mini_car.hint: Looks like a real car but fits in your hand — just for play!

plastic_dino.label: Plastic dinosaur
plastic_dino.hint: Shaped like an animal but made of plastic for kids to play!

rc_helicopter.label: Remote-control helicopter
rc_helicopter.hint: It can fly with spinning blades but it's just a battery toy.

pineapple.label: Pineapple
pineapple.hint: Spiky and bumpy — looks a bit like a hedgehog!

owl.label: Owl
owl.hint: Called an 'owl' but it's a night-flying bird.

otter.label: Otter
otter.hint: Looks like a water cat but swims amazingly well!

red_melon.label: Red watermelon
red_melon.hint: Green outside, red inside — but it's in the melon family!

lego_piece.label: Lego brick
lego_piece.hint: Looks like a plastic building block but snaps into toys!

robotCommands.instruction: Tap commands to line them up. Press Run to watch Buddy Bot move step by step!

levelSelect.bannerAlt: Buddy Bot arranging commands on a grid
levelSelect.title: Robot Commands
levelSelect.subtitle: The robot follows your steps — no magic! Pick a level.
levelSelect.easyHint: 3×3 grid · Move 1, Turn right, Pick apple
levelSelect.hardHint: 4×4 grid · Add Move 2 and Turn left

easy_1.title: First step
easy_1.hint: Add one more command so the robot can pick the apple!

easy_2.title: Turn the right way
easy_2.hint: Move forward 2, turn right once, move 2 more, then pick the apple!

easy_3.title: Small loop
easy_3.hint: The robot needs to turn a few times to reach the apple.

easy_4.title: Basic finish
easy_4.hint: Move sideways 2, turn right once, move up 2, then pick the apple!

hard_1.title: Fix one command
hard_1.hint: One command in the starter list is wrong — fix it!

hard_2.title: Move two squares
hard_2.hint: Sometimes Move 2 squares helps the robot go faster.

hard_3.title: The hallway
hard_3.hint: Hallway on the right — go down to the apple. Try Move 2 for speed!

hard_4.title: Final challenge
hard_4.hint: Go sideways, turn right, go down to the apple. Try Move 2 to keep it short!

round_5.question: What game should Buddy Bot suggest for this friend?

round_8.question: Which way should you NOT use to get better AI game suggestions?

guide.title: 4 easy steps guide
guide.ttsText: AI training guide in 4 easy steps. Step 1: Name 3 groups. Tap the text box in each group to name it. Step 2: Turn on the camera and take photos. Take 3 to 5 photos per group from different angles. Step 3: Train AI. Press train so the robot learns your examples. Step 4: Try live predictions.

step_1.title: Name 3 groups
step_1.desc: Tap each group's text box to name it yourself! Examples: 'Smiley face 😊', 'Pencil ✏️', 'Phone 📱'.

step_2.title: Turn on camera & take photos
step_2.desc: Press 'Turn on camera'. Use pens, books, toys, or color cards — avoid real face photos!

step_3.title: Train your AI
step_3.desc: After photos for at least 2 different groups, press 'Train your AI' below so the robot starts learning.

step_4.title: Try robot predictions
step_4.desc: When training is done, move in front of the camera — confidence bars will show the robot's guess!

webcam.title: 📹 Data collector
webcam.privacyNote: For best learning, use school objects instead of real faces. Photos stay in your browser and are not sent to the server.
